import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Fix negative quantities and revenues (set to 0)
    df.loc[df['Quantity'] < 0, 'Quantity'] = 0
    df.loc[df['Revenue'] < 0, 'Revenue'] = 0
    # Standardize Region labels (strip spaces, title case)
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].fillna('')
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Ensure numeric columns are numeric (already numeric per spec)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Average unit price per Category
    result = df.groupby('Category')['Price'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
